A Davaka king sent an ambassador to China in 428 AD (after the end…

c. 422: Kalyanavarman of Kamarupa absorbs Davaka. "absorbed much earlier in the first half of the 5th century during the reign of Kalyana Varman" (reign 422-446; Puri: "It is presumed that (Kalyana Varman) conquered Davaka"); the page records Davaka's embassy to China in 428, which does not fit an absorption before…

certainty.note: No border is given; the kingdom is a river valley named by the Allahabad Pillar as one of five frontier kingdoms.
